sideEffects: Private configuration, operation records and screenshots
Account selection; explicit selections remain active, queries restore the original account
Explicit simulated-account batch submission (one Windows worker, up to fifteen orders)
Explicit real-account default-price batch submission after a reviewed holdings plan and user confirmation
Explicit real-account market-order batch submission after a reviewed holdings plan and user confirmation
limitations: Client display freshness, not broker-server verification
Holdings require Codex image review; clipped rows cannot be accepted as complete
Equal fund displays can prevent automatic account switching
Individual orders remain simulated-only; real-account execution supports confirmed market or default-price batches; cancellation is unavailable
Market-order acceptance and fill remain untested in a live funded account
Unknown submission outcome must not be retried automatically
